messages.subject: Project Polaris - engagement and kick-off
messages.plaintextBody:
Charles,

Great to be working with you again after Atlas. Please find attached our engagement letter for the Larkfield acquisition (Project Polaris). Once you've had a chance to review, a signed copy back would be appreciated.

We propose a kick-off call on Thursday to agree the timetable and the due diligence scope. James will circulate a draft DD questionnaire beforehand.

Kind regards,

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 0012
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
